name: section_heading
label: Section Heading
help_text: Heading shown above the profile card.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: member_since_label
label: Member Since Label
help_text: Label shown before the member's join date.

name: logout_text
label: Logout Link Text
help_text: Text of the logout link shown below the member's email.

name: stat_1_label
label: Stat 1 Label
help_text: Label for the first stat card. Value is pulled from CRM contact property 'membership_points'.

name: stat_2_label
label: Stat 2 Label
help_text: Label for the second stat card. Value is pulled from CRM contact property 'total_referrals'.

name: stat_3_label
label: Stat 3 Label
help_text: Label for the third stat card. Value is pulled from CRM contact property 'total_redemptions'.

name: stat_3_sublabel
label: Stat 3 Sub-label
help_text: Second line of the third stat card label (wraps below main label).

name: tab_personal_label
label: Tab: Personal Details
help_text: Label for the Personal Details tab.

name: tab_wealth_label
label: Tab: Wealth Hub
help_text: Label for the Wealth Hub tab.

name: edit_profile_text
label: Edit Profile Button Text
help_text: Text of the button that enables editing of the personal details form.

name: cancel_text
label: Cancel Button Text
help_text: Text shown on the Edit Profile button when in editing mode (to cancel changes).

name: save_changes_text
label: Save Changes Button Text
help_text: Text of the form submit button on the personal details form.

name: personal_form
label: Personal Details Form
help_text: Select the 'Update Profile' form. Create it first in HubSpot Marketing > Forms.

name: edit_wealth_text
label: Wealth Hub Edit Button Text
help_text: Text of the Edit button on the Wealth Hub panel.

name: wealth_form
label: Wealth Hub Form
help_text: Select the HubSpot form for the Wealth Hub tab. Create a single form in Marketing > Forms with all wealth fields (assets, properties, liabilities, etc.).
